svg.title: Correlated input features permit error compensation
svg.desc: One calibration input [1, 1], weights [0.6, 0.6], reference output 1.2. Quantizing the first weight to 1 leaves remaining weight 0.2 to preserve output before its own quantization. Rounding it to 0 gives output 1, error −0.2. Independent rounding gives [1, 1], output 2, error 0.8.

g.text: A different input can reverse this comparison; held-out quality matters.
